scripts.dev: npm run build -w @partyverse/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @partyverse/server" "npm run dev -w @partyverse/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @partyverse/shared && npm run db:generate -w @partyverse/server && npm run build -w @partyverse/server && npm run build -w @partyverse/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @partyverse/shared && npm run test -w @partyverse/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @partyverse/shared && npm run typecheck -w @partyverse/server && npm run typecheck -w @partyverse/web
